blurb: Offers guided fishing charters including fly fishing, inshore, nearshore, and shark fishing. Trips target species like redfish, sea trout, tarpon, sharks, and more. Charters provide all necessary gear, fishing licenses, and fish cleaning service.
extraNote: $100 deposit required to reserve spot · 3 day cancellation notice required for full refund · Captain reserves right to cancel trip due to weather or safety; full deposit refund if cancelled · Full payment not required until after trip · Most trips depart from Georgetown, SC; can also depart from Debordieu, Murrells Inlet, McClellanville, or Awendaw on request.
